create_IMUBasedCOMVelocityEstimator: create an IMUBasedCOMVelocityEstimator instance with a quadruped robot and configurable Kalman filter variance parameters
update_velocity_estimate: update the estimated center of mass velocity using IMU sensor data and stance foot velocities
reset_estimator: reset the Kalman filter state and moving window filters to initial zero-mean distribution
